script:
Script of the home (scenes): scenes: home, night, away, set at a person's word; away suggested when the home empties, night left at dawn on a word; arriving home ends away
- move scene set: "I switch the home to its {S} mode."; needs cmd scene(S), mode(M), other(M,S); leaves mode(S), began(S), done(scene).
- move scene already: "The home is already in its {S} mode."; needs cmd scene(S), mode(S) (kept); leaves refused(scene).
- move suggest away: "Nobody seems to be home: shall I set the home to away?"; needs left home, mode(home) (kept); leaves suggest(away).
- move left settled: "Nobody is home, and the home is already set for it."; needs left home, mode(away) (kept); leaves welcomed.
- move suggest away night: "Nobody seems to be home, at night: shall I set the home to away?"; needs left home, mode(night) (kept); leaves suggest(away).
- move arrive: "Welcome home: I set the home back from away."; needs came home, mode(away); leaves mode(home), began(home), welcomed.
- move arrive home: "Someone came home."; needs came home, mode(home) (kept); leaves welcomed.
- move arrive night: "Someone came home at night."; needs came home, mode(night) (kept); leaves welcomed.
- move morning: "The sun is up: shall I end the night?"; needs dawn, mode(night) (kept); leaves suggest(home).
- move morning day: "The sun is up."; needs dawn, mode(home) (kept); leaves welcomed.
- move morning away: "The sun is up; the home is away."; needs dawn, mode(away) (kept); leaves welcomed.
- things it counts: occupied; empty; vacant; unsensed; someone home; nobody home; home unsensed; day; night; running; stopped; heater on; heater off; unit ok; unit missing; on b; power; entered; left home; came home; dawn; mode; cmd scene; done; refused; began; suggest; welcomed

out.text: I switch the home to its night mode.
The home is already in its night mode.
out.reason: The home is already in its night mode

out.text: The sun is up: shall I end the night?
I switch the home to its home mode.
Nobody seems to be home: shall I set the home to away?
I switch the home to its away mode.
Welcome home: I set the home back from away.
